driver: The decisive quantity is what an automatic action changed across the whole system, which its own log overstates three ways: the log loses the busiest periods' records exactly when the action fails most, the action's gain at one unit is partly undone hours later at the neighbouring unit that absorbs it, a harm no record links back to the action, and the devices that carry it out fail under a condition their periodic tests never meet; the forward value then rests on works the plan dates earlier than the organisation's own record of past works supports.
driver_concrete: FLISR's 2026 sustained interruptions avoided are the customers it restored within five minutes, with the sequences the ADMS archive dropped on storm days read back from the outage record's restoration steps and the devices' own operation records, less the customers its own switching put out: closes onto mislocated faults, and the receiving feeder's midline recloser tripping on the combined load hours after a summer transfer, coded no cause found; the controls whose batteries cannot crank at the design cold are read from weekly self-test sag against temperature, since spring and autumn functional tests pass them; and summer auto-transfer stays off on the directions whose reinforcement the capital works history says will not be in service by the 2027 summer.

lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is what restoring a unit's condition removes from its next-period event count, which is only the part of its event rate that has grown since the condition was last restored, per unit of an exposure that drives every event; the latest counts mix that growth with each unit's own base and with an exposure that moved in opposite directions across areas, so the units that look worst were selected on a high-exposure year or on a high base the restoration cannot touch, and the units with the most to gain look ordinary.

lineage.niche: a Philippine electric cooperative's referral rule for the overhead protection zones whose lightning protection (arrester ground leads, line arresters, pin insulators) has failed, built from recloser event logs on their own clocks and a lightning location extract, ahead of the 2027 dry-season refit
lineage.driver: Events counted per unit are recorded by instruments that keep their own drifting time and only their last few hundred records, read on an observer's schedule, so the units with the most events lose the most and line up the worst with the independent record that classifies them; the expected count each unit should have is learned only from unit-periods that a later physical check confirmed sound, and the alarm threshold carries the spread those confirmed units show beyond chance.
lineage.stump: A careful run that matches the radio-less controllers' trips to strokes on a wide window around their own stamps, counts only the events their memories kept and fits the sound-protection rate on every season no inspection has yet found failed refers 2 zones against 15: the baseline holds the failing zones it should judge, the wide window counts storm trips as lightning and the lost and unread months are missing, so the season totals, the radio-less faults, the failed-protection faults, the alert load, the inspection check and the avoided faults are all off, each by a different route.
lineage.answer: refer BGS-F3-R2, BGS-F5-R2, BTG-F1-R3, CBR-F2-R2, CLB-F5-R1, DLP-F2-R2, DLP-F4, LRD-F1-R1, LRD-F2, LRD-F2-R1, LRD-F3-R3, MPD-F2-R1, PGP-F1-R2, PGP-F2-R3 and SNJ-F1 for the 2027 refit (15 zones); the rule refers a zone when its lightning faults since its last cyclic inspection exceed the inspection-confirmed sound expectation by more than their scatter allows, at 1 in 855 a zone a season

lineage.driver: Events counted per unit are judged against what each unit gives when sound, and units differ persistently beyond any recorded feature, so the null must carry a level per unit learned from that unit's independently verified periods outside the record being judged, and carry that level's uncertainty into the tail; a scatter taken period by period passes the units that always run high as failures and hides the low ones that fail, a level taken as known breaks the false-alarm budget, and the value of acting is the state each failure has reached, not the record's average
lineage.driver_concrete: Each zone's lightning faults are its reclosers' trips matched to located strokes on each controller's own clock with the overwritten and unread months restored; what its lines would have had with sound protection is the register-feature rate times its own level (soil, hardware, route), learned from the seasons a later inspection confirmed it sound; the referral is the predictive tail of its record since inspection at one sound zone in five seasons across the network; the refit is valued on the 2026 state
lineage.stump: A careful run that rebuilds the record and learns from inspection-confirmed seasons but takes the scatter season by season refers 13 zones against 11 (it adds two that run high whenever sound, and a third, and drops a failed zone that runs low), replays 2, 5, 4, 10 and 13 referrals against 2, 2, 4, 8 and 11, checks 8 referrals at inspection with one found sound, and values the refit on each zone's record since inspection averaged (83 against 116); one that finds each zone's level but takes it as known refers 17 and would refer a sound zone 1.2 times a season against the terms' 0.2
